q: What is the materiality level in CBAM verification?
title: CBAM verification materiality: 5%
short: 5% of the specific embedded emissions per tonne, for each good by CN code, and 5% of the specific embedded free allocation. Misstatements above that, alone or together, are material. Every misstatement found still has to be corrected; materiality is not a tolerance band.
audience: Indian operators preparing CBAM emissions reports and the consultants helping them

ul: To plan how much data to sample.
To judge whether the report can get a positive verification statement.
For other parameters, the verifier uses expert judgement.

p: A verifier can treat a smaller error as material for qualitative reasons, for example if it points to a weak control system.

senseible: Senseible keeps the invoices behind each fuel and electricity figure in one fingerprinted record, so a verifier can sample them without a hunt through files. Senseible is not a CBAM verifier and does not issue verification reports.
